text:
maria: Heads-up: We're scheduling a coordinated base-image harden + rootless-runtime flip for staging tomorrow. Need RBAC changes (signer SA), KMS key policy, and audit exports ready before the rebuild pipeline runs. Who's got bandwidth for final sign-off?

ben: In-scope images? Are we touching both runtime/base:debian-core and runtime/lang:python-min? Need exact digests for the pipeline.

maria: Yes both. Current manifests: debian-core@sha256:dd33... python-min@sha256:ee44... I'll paste the manifest files into the PR. Primary change is adding fewer packages, reprovisioning seccomp profile, and switching to rootless runtime flag on canary nodes.

alisa: RBAC: signer service account (images-signer@infra) must get kms.cryptoSign and iam.serviceAccounts.actAs on the signer's attach role. Recommend creating role 'infra.imageSigner' scoped to projects/redwood. Terraform snippet will be in my PR. Also we need to ensure the key policy prevents deletion without 2-owner approval (compliance ask).

sam: Cosign signing example (pipeline step):
```
# sign with KMS-backed key (GCP) and attach sbom link
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/imgs/cryptoKeys/cosign-main \n  --annotations sbom=https://sbom.internal/rebuilds/479001.json,rebuild=479001 \n  gcr.io/redwood/runtime/debian-core@sha256:dd33...
```

security-oncall: Triage policy reminder: any newly introduced CVE with CVSS >= 7.5 pauses the rollout and triggers incident-runbook-3. Attach full SBOM and image attestations to the ticket. Audit events must include trace_id, signer_principal, key_version, image_digest. Long-term export to splunk-audit required.

dana: Quick note on audit fields: Datadog expects logs as JSON with keys: principal, key_version, image_digest, annotations, cosign_sig, trace_id, env. We'll need the logging shim in the signer sidecar to conform. I can add the mapping in the shim repo.

ben: Approval flow: who signs the Terraform PR for the new IAM role? iam-admins or security leads? Need to avoid mid-rollout churn.

alisa: Assign approvers: iam-admins group + @security-oncall. I'll request a two-day review window but we'll push an exception for urgent compliance fixes. PR will include plan output and binding details.

maria: Canary plan: label 6 staging nodes with image-canary=true, flip runtime.rootless=true on those nodes. Deploy signed images to the canary pods only. Monitor liveness, startup latency, and auth failures for 6 hours. If stable, expand to 30% for another 12h. If any auth-to-kms or signature-verification errors, rollback.

sam: node flip commands:
```
kubectl label node <node> image-canary=true
# cordon + drain to force restart with new runtime flag
kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m
```

devops-bot: queued: pipeline rebuild-image-harden #479001 (ETA ~90m). CI artifacts and cosign logs will be archived at: https://ci.internal/479001/logs :hourglass_flowing_sand:

security-oncall: Add fallback: dual-key verification window. Pipeline should publish both current and previous cosign public keys and try verification against both. If KMS returns transient 503, pause and alert on-call. Also update incident-playbook with steps for key-rotation rollback.

ben: Will image pull secrets or node IAM changes affect running production clusters? We must ensure vault tokens or node metadata calls won't be disrupted.

dana: We added a short-lived overlay that fetches KMS creds from metadata server. For staging canary we'll enable 'metadata-only' mode; prod rollout requires vault-backed token exchange. Documented in infra/keystore/README.md.

alisa: Terraform: I'll add key_versioning + disable_auto_delete=true + iam binding for images-signer. I'll ping iam-admins in the PR and include plan.

maria: Owners: maria (coord), alisa (IAM + terraform), sam (pipeline + cosign integration), ben (do/ops + rollback), dana (audit shim + logging), security-oncall (vuln triage + incident updates). 30m sync in #eng-security-review at 09:00 tomorrow to finalize PR merges.

maria: Please ack when you've pushed your PRs so we can gate the pipeline. :white_check_mark:
